description.value: O-Lake Cafe & Bistro is a dessert-focused cafe in downtown Kelowna specializing in handcrafted mille crepe cakes and elegant high tea, founded in 2022 by a designer-turned-baker who blends Western pastry technique with lighter Asian-inspired flavors. The cafe uses real seasonal ingredients and prepares each birthday cake fresh on the day of pickup. Private dining for intimate groups of 2–15 is also available, with custom multi-course menus.
